Resolves #19209

Two unit specs now convert between file URLs and paths portably, as the ticket prescribes.
- `distAppAssets.spec.mjs` derives its directory with `fileURLToPath`, so Windows no longer resolves `/G:/…` into `G:\G:\…`.
- `MainWorkspaceAddon.spec.mjs` builds each of the nine specifiers it hands to its child process with `pathToFileURL(…).href`, through a small `fileUrl(root, relativePath)` helper. Windows therefore no longer reads `G:\…` as a URL with the scheme `g:`.

`pathToFileURL` resolves no symlinks, so the engine path that the spec runs with `--preserve-symlinks` stays as given.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — two specs, conversion calls only.

Evidence: L2 (both specs run on macOS; Node's `windows: true` conversions reproduce both Windows failures from the old forms and the correct values from the new ones) → L2 required (the ACs are the conversions and Linux CI). Residual: none; the Windows run is the ticket's Post-Merge Validation.

## Deltas from ticket

## Test Evidence

- macOS, Node 25.9: both specs, 17 passed.
- Windows semantics through Node's `url` with `{windows: true}`:
  - Old: `path.win32.dirname(new URL(specUrl).pathname)` gives `/G:/Github/neo/test/playwright/unit/buildScripts`, the source of `G:\G:\…`. New: `fileURLToPath(specUrl, {windows: true})` gives `G:\Github\neo\…`, with repo root `G:\Github\neo`.
  - Old: `new URL('G:\Github\neo/src/Neo.mjs').protocol` is `g:`, the cause of `ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME`. New: `pathToFileURL(…, {windows: true}).href` gives `file:///G:/Github/neo/src/Neo.mjs`.
